title: Major disaster declared: Oakland Hills Fire, California (DR-919)
summary: FEMA major disaster declaration for California (fire), declared 1991-10-22.

title: KOLCRAFT ENTERPRISES, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (7,787 affected)
summary: THE SEAT SHELLS FAILED TO COMPLY WITH THE STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY STANDARDS OF FMVSS 213. THE PLASTIC SEAT SHELLS CRACKED DURING DYNAMIC IMPACT TESTING.

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL (669 affected)
summary: DUE TO A COMPUTER PROGRAM ERROR, CERTAIN DIGITS OF THE GVWR AND THE GAWR APPEARED IN INCORRECT LOCATIONS ON THE CERTIFICATION LABEL LOCATED ON THE LEFT FRONT DOOR OF THE SUBJECT VEHICLES.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: FUEL:FUEL PUMP (407 affected)
summary: THE FUEL SHUT-OFF SOLENOID IN THE CUMMINS 6C ENGINE MAY BE FAULTY, CAUSING SPONTANEOUS INTERRUPTION OF FUEL FLOW TO THE ENGINE DURING NORMAL OPERATION. THIS RESULTS IN LOSS OF POWER TO DRIVING WHEELS, POWER STEERING, AND OTHER POWER ASSISTED OPERATING SYSTEMS.

title: KOLCRAFT ENTERPRISES, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (48,742 affected)
summary: THE ARMRESTS ON THE CHILDSEAT CRACK AT THE POINTS WHERE THEY ARE ATTACHED TO THE SEAT BACK LEAVING SPRINGS AND SHARP PIECES OF PLASTIC EXPOSED. THESE CRACKS ARE CAUSED BY EXCESSIVE TENSION BETWEEN  THE SPRINGS AND THE PLASTIC OF THE ARMREST.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:TURN SIGNAL LIGHTS (19,950 affected)
summary: TURN SIGNAL CONTROL MODULES MAY CONTINUE TO FLASH IN THE PRESENCE OF A NON-FUNCTIONING TURN SIGNAL LAMP WHICH IS NONCONFORMANCE TO FMVSS 108.

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC (250 affected)
summary: IMPROPER ASSEMBLY COULD CAUSE THE BALL OF THE GEAR SELECTOR ARM NOT TO BE PROPERLY FIXED TO THE SOCKET ON THE END OF THE GEAR SELECTOR CABLE; GEAR SELECTOR ARM COULD SEPARATE FROM THE GEAR SELECTOR CABLE AT THE BALL SOCKET JOINT.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:FITTINGS (33,000 affected)
summary: THERE MAY BE HYDRAULIC FLUID CONTAMINATION FROM CONDENSATION FORMATION THAT CAN PLUG THE ABS BRAKE BOOSTER PUMP FILTER; STRESS CORROSION OF THE MASTER CYLINDER SNAP RING HAS BEEN TRACED TO CHLORINE LEAKING FROM THE LOW PRESSURE HYDRAULIC HOSE WHICH MAY CAUSE IT TO BREAK; FRONT BRAKE HOSE TO TIRE INTERFERENCE WHICH MAY CAUSE FAILURE OF THE BRAKE HOSE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): HEATER:ELECTRICAL:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:FAN MOTOR (125,000 affected)
summary: WATER LEAKING UNDER WINDSHIELD COWL IN AREA ABOVE HEATER BLOWER MOTOR RESISTOR BLOCK RESULTS IN CORROSION OF THE RESISTOR TERMINALS.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS (412,792 affected)
summary: FRONT SHOULDER SAFETY BELT WEBBING MAY SEPARATE AT FRONT BELT UPPER GUIDE LOOPS ON EITHER SIDE OF THE FRONT SEAT.

title: Adient, PLC: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY (73,085 affected)
summary: A MANUFACTURING FLAW IN THE TOP TERMINAL MAY CAUSE CRACKING OF THE BATTERY CASE.

title: Yokohama Tire Corporation: TIRES:BELT (9,317 affected)
summary: BELTS AND CARCASS PLIES MAY BREAK WHEN THE TIRE IS SUBJECTED TO EXTREME IMPACT.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDOW:REAR-VIEW BACKLIGHT (2,986 affected)
summary: RELEASE HANDLE FOR REAR PUSH OUT WINDOW IS NOT LOCATED IN AREA REQUIRED BY S5.2.3.1(B) OF FMVSS 217.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): BRAKES:MECHANICAL SERVICE:PEDAL (360 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE PEDAL PAD ATTACHMENT TO THE PEDAL ARM MAY NOT HAVE ADEQUATE STRENGTH DUE TO MISLOCATION OF WELDS, AND COULD BREAK.

title: LAG MOTORCOACH USA: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES AND FITTINGS (5 affected)
summary: THE AIR BRAKE LINES AND HOSES WERE BUILT AND IMPORTED ACCORDING TO EUROPEAN DIN STANDARDS, AND NOT U.S. D.O.T. FMVSS STANDARDS.

title: CHANCE COACH, INC.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (179 affected)
CHANCE COACH, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART (187 affected)
summary: WIRING OF THE TELL-TALE MODULE, LOCATED IN THE REAR GATE UNLOCK-UNLATCH MECHANISM, CAUSES THE REAR BRAKES TO BE APPLIED AND THE REAR GATE TO UNLATCH WHEN THE INSTRUMENT PANEL PUSH-TO-TEST LIGHT IS PRESSED.

title: Gillig, LLC: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:COOLING UNIT AN (62 affected)
summary: INCONSISTENT AEROQUIP HOSE TIGHTENING PROCEDURES AND SUPPLIER'S ASSEMBLY INCONSISTENCIES CAN CAUSE LEAKS OF HYDRAULIC FLUID.

title: IC CORPORATION: EQUIPMENT:EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL (500 affected)
summary: THE REAR EMERGENCY DOOR EXIT IDENTIFICATION AND THE OPERATING INSTRUCTIONS MAY NOT BE INSTALLED.

title: Gillig, LLC: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:COOLING UNIT AN (62 affected)
summary: A HYDRAULIC LEAK MAY DEVELOP IN THE WEBSTER COOLING FAN.

title: Gillig, LLC: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:COOLING UNIT AN (62 affected)
summary: A HYDRAULIC FLUID LEAK MAY DEVELOP IN THE WEBSTER HYDRAULIC PUMP.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:TREAD (684 affected)
summary: AN UNAUTHORIZED AND UNNAMED MATERIAL WAS INTRODUCED INTO THE TRUCK TIRE BASE STOCK, AND TIRES WERE BUILT AND CURED WITH THE MISCOMPOUNDED TRUCK TREAD BASE MATERIAL.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING (420 affected)
summary: THE HOOK SIZE OF THE THROTTLE RETURN SPRING IS TOO SMALL RESULTING IN A TIGHT FIT AROUND THE ANCHOR NUT, CAUSING THE THROTTLE RETURN SPRING TO BREAK PREMATURELY.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: BRAKES:121 AIR SYSTEM (49 affected)
summary: RESERVOIR INTERIOR PAINT WAS ALLOWED TO ENTER THE AIR RESERVOIR CHECK VALVE, AND THE VALVE IS NOT PROPERLY SEATED.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:STOVE (352 affected)
summary: THE COOKING RANGE AND THE FURNACE ARE LOCATED NEXT TO EACH OTHER IN THE MOTORHOME. WHEN THE FURNACE IS IN OPERATION, IT CAN DRAW AIR OVER THE RANGE TOP, CAUSING A DOWNDRAFT ONTO THE RANGE TOP.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT LATCH (1,851 affected)
summary: THE PASSENGER'S SIDE EASY-ENTRY SEAT ADJUSTER MAY FAIL FULLY LOCK INTO POSITION AFTER THE SEAT BACK HAS BEEN TILTED FORWARD AND THE SEAT SLID FORWARD, THEN RETURNED TO ITS ORIGINAL POSTITION.

title: General Motors, LLC: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC (10,642 affected)
summary: A MISADJUSTED TRANSMISSION CABLE CAN ALLOW THE ENGINE TO BE STARTED WHILE THE TRANSMISSION IS IN A FORWARD OR REVERSE DRIVE GEAR.

title: General Motors, LLC: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:3 SPEED:INTERLOCK ASSEMBL (1,573 affected)
summary: A MISADJUSTMENT OF THE PARK LOCK CABLE IN THE COLUMN SHIFT ASSEMBLY MAKES IT POSSIBLE FOR THE STEERING COLUMN TO LOCK WHILE THE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION AND THE IGNITION SWITCH IS IN THE OFF POSITION.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:4 SPEED:SHIFT PATTERN IND (308 affected)
summary: THE STONE BENNETT SHIFTERS DO NOT INDICATE THE RELATIVE POSITION OF THE SHIFT LEVER TO THE DRIVER.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (18 affected)
summary: THE LEFT AND RIGHT SEAT SAFETY BELT ASSEMBLIES ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE. SOME LEFT SEAT SAFETY BELT ASSEMBLIES WERE INSTALLED ON THE THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE CAR.

title: FERODO AMERICA, INC.: BRAKES:AIR CHAMBERS (2,400 affected)
summary: THE SPRING BRAKE UNITS CAN FAIL TO RELEASE FROM THE PARKING OR APPLIED POSITION DUE TO A MISALIGNMENT BETWEEN THE SPRING PLATE AND THE SPRING HOUSING. THE CONDITION CAN BE EITHER INTERMITTENT OR PERMANENT.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM SYSTEM (130 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES HAVE FRONT AXLES WITH BRAKE CAM OPERATION OPPOSITE TO THE ROTATION OF THE BRAKE DRUM (CAM OPPOSITE), AND THERE IS A TENDENCY FOR BRAKES TO CHATTER UNDER LOW AIR PRESSURE, RESULTING IN VIBRATIONS. THE VIBRATIONS INDUCE STRESSES IN THE TIE ROD END BEYOND ITS ENDURANCE LIMIT, AND RESULT IN CRACKS IN THE THREADED PORTION OF THE STUD WHERE THE TUBE ENDS.

title: General Motors, LLC: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES (224,588 affected)
summary: SECONDARY HOOD LATCH ASSEMBLIES CAN CORRODE, CAUSING A HIGH LATCH RELEASE EFFORT AND POSSIBLY PREVENTING THE HOOD FROM LATCHING PROPERLY WHEN IT IS CLOSED.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL (467 affected)
summary: THE INCOMPLETE VEHICLE DOCUMENT REQUIRED BY 49 CFR 568.4 HAS INCORRECT INFORMATION CONCERNING GVWR, FRONT GAWR, AND TIRE PRESSURES.
